name: Ad Hoc Semantic Reconciliation
description: The released artifact for work on ad hoc semantic reconciliation: the ability of cognitive agents to reconcile divergent network- and service-management models for the occasion, with no model agreed in advance. It contains the benchmark cases and their validated keys, a non-cognitive baseline, the reconciliation harness, the four-scenario study code and its released run outputs, and instrumented cognition traces together with the code that produces them, including a standalone note that reads the agents' reasoning turn by turn. Source repository: https://github.com/NOMS2027Janz/adhoc-semantic-reconciliation-artifact
